segments.name: Meridiani Plains and Purgatory
reasons: Flat plains, but a loose sand ripple ("Purgatory") trapped Opportunity for five weeks.

segments.name: Victoria Crater
reasons: Opportunity drove down into Victoria crater and back out along its slopes.

segments.name: Trek to Endeavour
reasons: Long, flat plains crossing between sand ripples.

segments.name: Endeavour Rim
reasons: Steep crater-rim slopes; Opportunity's steepest drives were here.
